Item 8.01

Other Events. 

On November 18, 2026, the waiting period under the U.S. Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended, with respect to Dominion Energy, Inc.’s previously disclosed combination with NextEra Energy, Inc., expired. The closing of the proposed combination remains subject to the satisfaction of other closing conditions, including certain other regulatory approvals.
